name: GelSight Wedge
description: A compact vision-based tactile sensor for robot fingers that reconstructs high-resolution 3D contact geometry.
citation: Shaoxiong Wang, Yu She, Branden Romero, and Edward Adelson. ‘GelSight Wedge: Measuring High-Resolution 3D Contact Geometry with a Compact Robot Finger.’ 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA), 2021. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2106.08851.
